newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus sees 1996 net up to PLN 17.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Optimus sees 1996 net up to PLN 17.5 mln.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA sees its net profit rising to 17.5 million zlotys in 1996 and to 10.7 million in the first half of 1997, the company said in its issue prospectus.
In 1995 the company earned net 9.2 million zlotys.
It said it wanted to boost earnings by improving quality of its products, expanding its sales network and the production of multi-media software.
It said its sales should grow to 517.5 million zlotys this year and to 272.5 million in the first half of 1997, against last year's revenue of 341.7 million zlotys. @
Optimus said its group net profit was expected to grow to 21 million zlotys this year and to 14.2 million zlotys in the first half of 1997, up from last year's 12.2 million zlotys.
